settings.install: documented self-hosted docker compose defaults, configured for provider anthropic and model claude-sonnet-5-5
settings.model_calls: must go through the metering proxy at <proxy>/b/melete; 0.2.1 has no setting for the Anthropic base URL, so a published run needs a build that has one (the report warns when no call of this bot reached the proxy)
settings.approvals: product defaults; the bench answers every card with the uniform policy
settings.connections: none (no mail, calendar or messaging accounts)

notes: The health route reports the version only; the commit above is the one deployed.
The account must be a fresh account (the first one made on the install) with no messaging connections.
